heading: Organization
lead: The National American Indian Veterans, Incorporated, a nonprofit corporation organized in the United States (referred to in this chapter as the “corporation”), is a federally chartered corporation.
sourceCredit: (Added Pub. L. 118–31, div. E, title LI, § 5103(a), Dec. 22, 2023, 137 Stat. 935.)
